summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Northern Trust US Quality Large Cap ETF (QLC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of the highest quality large-caps in the US market. QLC was launched on Sep 24, 2015 and is issued by Northern Trust.
infoTable: Northern Trust Quality Large Cap Total Return

holdings.infoBox: QLC is an equity ETF with a total of 162 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.96%, Alphabet at 7.29%, Apple at 5.83%, Microsoft at 4.00%, and Broadcom at 2.65%.
